alt_text: The main message is Attention Is All You Need: No Recurrence Required. The page features an abstract illustration of interconnected shapes.
The parallelization bottleneck compares recurrent and transformer models. Recurrent models are sequential, while transformers allow for significantly more parallelization.
The Transformer architecture relies entirely on attention mechanisms. The diagram illustrates the encoder-decoder structure with self-attention layers.
Self-attention relates positions in a sequence. The image shows Scaled Dot-Product and Multi-Head Attention mechanisms for computing weights.
Transformer Translation Results show state-of-the-art quality after 12 hours on 8 P100 GPUs, achieving better BLEU scores at lower cost.
Big Transformer Results show that the model achieves a BLEU score of 28.4 on WMT English-to-German and 41.0 on English-to-French at a lower training cost.

Limitations and Future Directions. Reduced effective resolution occurs due to averaging attention-weighted positions. Future work extends the Transformer to other modalities and investigates local attention mechanisms.
Attention heads learn syntactic and semantic structures. The visualization shows attention head patterns related to sentence structure.
